Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...], "files": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": one address for a single person, otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants (see attendee_update.csv)". Addresses are in the attached csv files.
- In your sandbox create revised_schedule.ics and attendee_update.csv (only the affected people: name, email, group, what changed) and return them as files.

messages.subject: Venue change for CodeSprint on 21 November
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. The event moves to Espace Mont Louis (11e). Please allow about 20 extra minutes to get there. The rest of the programme timing is being confirmed and we will send the final times shortly.

messages.subject: Workshop room change
messages.body:
Hello,

Your workshop with Speaker 2 moves to Espace Mont Louis (11e), room B. The start time (10:00-11:00) is unchanged. Please allow about 20 extra minutes to get there.

messages.subject: Venue change: your keynote at 09:00
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. Your opening keynote at 09:00 moves to Espace Mont Louis (11e). Please allow about 20 extra minutes to get there.

messages.subject: Venue change: your workshop at 10:00
messages.body:
Hello,

Your workshop (10:00-11:00) moves to Espace Mont Louis (11e), room B. The time is unchanged. Please allow about 20 extra minutes to get there, especially since you are arriving by train.

messages.subject: Venue change: awards hosting at 16:30
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. The awards at 16:30 move to Espace Mont Louis (11e). Please allow about 20 extra minutes to get there.

messages.subject: Volunteer meet-up moved to Espace Mont Louis
messages.body:
Hello,

The 07:45 volunteer meet-up moves from the main hall to Espace Mont Louis (11e). Please allow about 30 extra minutes to get there.

messages.subject: Catering delivery location change
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. The 12:00 delivery of 200 meals (20 vegetarian, 8 vegan, 4 gluten-free) moves to Espace Mont Louis (11e). Please confirm the revised delivery location and that 12:00 still works.
